_about: API-equivalent USD per million tokens, used by chief-run.py for cost estimates. On a subscription this shows where usage went, not what is billed. A model missing here is reported as unpriced, never guessed. long_context rates apply per request when that request's prompt exceeds above_input_tokens. Claude transcripts give usage per request, so Claude long-context rates are applied; Codex reports one total per job, so Codex jobs are priced at short-context rates and a job whose requests ran past 272K input tokens is under-estimated.

claude._source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, read 2026-11-12. Every model below except Haiku 5.5 is priced the same across its whole context window.

chatgpt._source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (Standard tier, text tokens), read 2026-11-12. Short context is up to 272K input tokens per request, long context above it. Cached input is part of input; reasoning is part of output.
